the preparation of microparticle flocculants and their application in the treatment of wastewater.
the preparation of a kind of new flocculant with high efficiency and low dosage,which has great significance to the sewage treatment in the oil field.
the preparation of micropartical flocculants with high performances and the study on the mechanism of flocculating performances.

microparticulate inorganic flocculants have a great application value in water treatment.
the inorganic microparticle flocculant is a promising alternative to traditional flocculants.

the microparticulate inorganic flocculants with high efficiency and high stability can be prepared by sol-gel method with the assistant components of P,Mg,Zr,Zn,Mn,Fe,Al,Co and so on.

the flocculants with microparticles as core and inorganic polymers as shell are more efficient and more economical than the traditional commercial flocculants.

flocculants with microparticulate structure are superior in flocculating performance to the commercial polyaluminum and can be used as flocculants in oilfield sewage treatment.
flocculants prepared by using sol as the base and with the assistant components as P, Mg, Zn, Mn and Co have good flocculating performances.
